product_metadata.title: Nestl Extra Twin Deep Pocket Sheets Set - 4 PC Soft Microfiber Twin Sheets Deep Pocket - Fade Resistant Bedding Sheets & Pillowcases - Twin, Hunter Green
features: EXTRA DEEP POCKET SHEETS: Deep pocket sheets fit deep pocket 18, 20, 21, 22, and 24-inch mattresses. These are great for extra deep matresses/large matresses/very tall matresses and fits well matresses with 3 inch or 4 inch memory foam mattress toppers, double pillow top, memory foam toppers, or big mattress pads!

TWIN SIZED: includes one extra deep pocket fitted sheet, 1 flat sheet, and two pillowcases. Extra deep pocket fitted sheet measures 75 inches x 39 inches with 21-inch pockets. Flat Sheets measure 96 inches x 66 inches. Pillowcases measure 20 x 30 inches. Also available in Twin, Twin XL, Full, Full XL, Queen, and King sizes.
SUPER SOFT PREMIUM MICROFIBER: Hotel-quality bedding is woven from the highest quality microfiber material, double brushed on both sides for ultimate softness and comfort.

ELEGANT AND VIBRANT: our bedding is pet-friendly and made to last. Our fabulous selection of vibrant colors won’t fade after washing and the classic stripe detail is a beautiful, elegant way to update your bedroom.

100% SATISFACTION: Welcome to the Nestl Bedding family! Our #1 goal is to provide you with unparalleled customer service and we’re only happy if our customers are happy! Shop with confidence because no matter what, we’ve got you covered!
